rule_outs: Dwelling 6 m from the best section
summary: Steep narrow street, houses hard against the west kerb, no-parking sign.

drivers.seclusion: Detached houses line the west side, the nearest 6 m from the kerb.
drivers.access_and_room: Narrow sealed lane with no verge on the west; kerb-to-fence.
drivers.traffic: Quiet street joining a busier road at the north end.
drivers.convention: A couple of cars park here, but a No Parking Any Time sign is posted nearby.

sun_shade: Mixed tree shade, mostly over the northern half.
